Commentary.Commentary: Right then. England have made it two wins in two games. They haven’t been troubled in this competition and look to be on the right track to make it to the semi-finals. But, the action does not end here. We have one more game coming up. This time, it is Scotland and Namibia who go head-to-head at 6 pm local (2 pm GMT). Do join us then. Cheers!

Eoin Morgan, the skipper of England, says that their bowlers have been doing a great job and the fielding has also been great. Adds that their white-ball cricket has come along nicely and they have been brilliant since 2019. Credits Jason Roy by saying that he did a fantastic job for them with the bat and started strong up front.

Mahmudullah, the skipper of Bangladesh, says that he is disappointed with the performance. Tells that they are lacking to capitalize in the Powerplay and at the end as well. Mentions that they want to be a skilled hitter rather than a power hitter team. Tells that they have to reassess and come back stronger in the next game.

Jason Roy wins the Man of the Match award for his half-century which helped his side to get over the line with ease. Roy is in for a chat. He says that the credit goes to the bowlers as they are doing well for us. Adds that start of his career was more of a sporadic but now he gets more consecutive games. Adds that a good start is a key but these pitches are hard to bat on but the key was to keep the wickets in hand.
... PRESENTATION TIME ...

Earlier in the first innings. Mahmudullah’s decision to bat first, did not go as per the plan. England bowlers ran riot and kept down Bangladesh to a below-par score of 124/9. Later, their batters came out and motored along pretty well to take away the game from the Bangla Tigers.

Bangladesh bowlers were not on the money. Unlike the England bowlers, Bangladesh pacers found it very hard to keep things tight with the ball. They kept struggling with their lines and lengths. No bowler stood out, as such. Nasum Ahmed and Shoriful Islam were the only ones to find success with the ball. They will be disappointed with their performance. Bangladesh now see themselves in the must-win category, after two consecutive defeats in this campaign.

There is joy in the English dressing room, thanks to Roy! The opening pair, got off to a great start. The runs kept flowing in this innings. Although, Buttler slipped out inside the Powerplay. Malan came in and batted sensibly alongside Roy. They stitched a crucial partnership to take their side close to the finish line. But Roy gave away his wicket at 61. In the end, Bairstow and Malan did the finishing touches to get their side over the line.

England have won their second game of the tournament and are placed comfortably at the top of the table in their group. They are yet to be challenged in this competition. Both the times, their bowlers set the platform and the batters then came in to complete the task. Bangladesh, on the other hand, could not put up a good fight and the Lions have silenced the Tiger's for the first time in T20 World Cup.

FOUR! There it is! Jonny Bairstow finishes things off with a boundary! Islam bangs it into the deck, around off. Bairstow hangs back and pulls it in front of square to seal the game! England WIN THE MATCH BY 8 WICKETS!
Full ball, on the pads. Jonny Bairstow flicks it to mid-wicket and collects a run. 3 runs needed off 36 balls!
Back of a length, around off. Dawid Malan taps it to backward point. The fielder there fumbles and the batters take one.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Short of a length, outside off. Dawid Malan hangs back and powers it over cover for a boundary. England are only one hit away now!
Short of a length, on middle. Jonny Bairstow tucks it to the leg side and takes an easy single.
Length ball, strayed on the pads. Dawid Malan tickles it to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Dawid Malan taps it to backward point.
Mushfiqur Rahim is back into the attack.
Jonny Bairstow is off the mark! Length ball, outside off. Bairstow prods and drives it to cover. The fielder there fumbles and concedes a couple of runs. Just 11 runs needed now from 42 balls!
Jonny Bairstow is the new man in. 13 needed in 43 balls.

OUT! TAKEN! Too little too late for Bangladesh but they will take this one! Islam bangs it into the deck, around off. Roy plays the late cut and looks to go over third man. The ball goes off the splice of the blade and goes towards Nasum Ahmed who runs forward and takes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Nasum Ahmed b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, outside off. Dawid Malan steers it to third man and collects one.
Length ball, around off. Jason Roy pushes it to cover and takes off for a run.
SIX! Cheeky from Jason Roy! He looks in total control out there! A slower ball, into the pitch, around middle. Roy shuffles across and scoops it over the keeper's head for a maximum!
Good-length ball, on leg. Jason Roy misses the flick and gets hit high on his pad.
Loopy ball, on middle. Dawid Malan gets low and miscues his slog-sweep to wide of long on for a run.
Flatter ball, on middle. Jason Roy tucks it to the leg side for one.
SIX! WHACKED! What a way to bring up the fifty-run mark! Tossed up, in the slot, on off. Jason Roy smacks it over the bowler's head for a maximum!
Quicker ball, coming in with the angle from middle. Jason Roy misses his nudge and gets hit on the pad.
Floated, around off. Dawid Malan prods and eases it to long off to collect a run.
Tossed up, outside off. Jason Roy drills it to long off for a single.
Nasum Ahmed is back on.
Three dots in a row to end the over. Full and on off. Malan pushes it towards extra cover.
Touch short and outside off. Malan cuts it to the left of point. The fielder there moves thats side to make a great stop.
Short ball, on off. Malan defends it to point.
Another single! Touch short and on middle. Roy pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
On a length, around off. Malan hangs back and punches it through point for a single.
Back of a length, on the bodyline. Roy swivel and pulls it towards fine leg. The batters take a single, as there is a man in the deep.

DRINKS! England are motoring along nicely and it is just a matter of time before they get over the line! Bangladesh have failed to pick up wickets early on and that has kept them behind in this contest! Shoriful Islam comes back to bowl. 9 runs came off his first over!
Flighted, full and on leg. Roy makes room and pushes it down the ground to long on for another single. 90 up for England at the halfway mark. They are in full control at the moment.
On off, Malan eases it to long off for a run.
Slower through the air. Full and on the pads. Roy tucks it towards long on and the batters cross.
Tossed up, on off. Malan flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! And again. Full and down leg. Malan leaves it alone. Umpire calls it as a wide.
WIDE! Slower. A bit of turn but down the leg side. Malan leaves it alone. Wide called.
Full and on off. Malan prods and defends it to the leg side.
Darted on the pads. Roy works it towards long on for a single.
Shakib Al Hasan (2-0-17-0) is back on.
7 runs coming off this over. England are cruising at the moment. Flatter and short, outside off. Roy hangs back and punches it to cover for a run.
Full and on off. Malan eases it to long off for another single.
Flatter and outside off. Roy slashes it through covers for another single.
Another single now! Floated, full and on off. Malan pushes it down to long off for a single.
Full toss and on middle. Roy pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Full and on off. Roy reverse sweeps it through point. The batters take two before the fielder cuts it out.
WIDE! Bangladesh cannot afford to give away extras at this point. Full and going down leg. Roy leaves it alone. Wide called.
FOUR! Plays with proper timing! A full ball, slanting outside off. Malan lifts it over extra cover and beats the running long off fielder for the second boundary in the over. 50 needed in 72 balls.
Angles a flatter ball, on middle. Roy flicks it away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, eased down to long on for a single.
Flatter again, around leg and this is worked away to deep mid-wicket for one more.
Flatter on middle. Malan turns it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Innovative! A full ball, on middle. Malan reverse paddles it past short third man for a boundary. Just helps the ball on its way to run down the ground.
Nasum Ahmed comes back into the attack now. He replaces Mustafizur Rahman.
Floated, around off, pushed to deep cover for a single. 62 runs needed in 78 balls.
On middle, tucked away to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! Flatter and on middle. Roy cuts it off the back foot through point for a boundary.

SIX! Not out of the middle but fetches himself a maximum! A tossed up ball, on middle. Roy skips down but does not reach to the pitch of the bowl. Hits it straight down the ground where Naim from long on leaps but fails to catch it. Maximum.
Fuller again, on middle. Malan pushes to the left of the bowler who dives but lets it through for another single.
Fuller and on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Mahedi Hasan comes into the attack now. He replaces Nasum Ahmed.

FOUR LEG BYES! An appeal for LBW but not given! A length ball, angling on the pads. Roy again tries t flick it away but misses and gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls away to the fine leg fence. Rahman puts up an appeal but the umpire is not interested. Might be pitching outside leg. At the end of the Powerplay, England are 50/1.
FOUR! Easy pickings! A length ball, on the pads. Roy tickles it fine and the ball runs away past short fine leg to the fence.
Length ball, on off. Malan taps it to covers and takes a quick single. He is off the mark.
A length ball, on off. Malan solidly blocks it out.
Full and on off, pushed through covers for a single.

Review Time! Mahmudullah decides to take it upstairs for caught behind. The on-field decision is not out. The UltraEdge shows there is no spike as the ball passes the bat. The on-field decision stands. Bangladesh lose a review here and have only 1 left in the bank now.

NOT OUT! Rahman slants this one on a length, outside off. Roy is in an awkward position as he dances down and tries to tuck it on the leg side but misses it. The keeper collects and puts up an appeal but nothing given. Mahmudullah takes the review and Ultra Edge shows nothing on it. Review lost by Bangladesh and Roy survives.
Single to end the over! Around off, pushed down to long off for a single.
Who will walk out now? Dawid Malan comes to the middle now at number three.

OUT! TAKEN! There is the wicket Bangladesh were looking for! Ahmed angles a flatter ball, on a length and on off, Jos Buttler rocks on his back foot and looks to go over extra cover but does not execute it well. Skies it up and hits it to wide of long off where Mohammad Naim runs to his left and takes a good running catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Naim b Nasum Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and on middle. Buttler punches it to covers.
Slants this one on middle, Jos Buttler rocks back and punches it back to the bowler.
Darted on the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Angles a full ball, on middle. Defended out.
Nasum Ahmed comes into the attack now.
A single to end the over! Good-length ball, down leg. Jos Buttler tickles it to fine leg for a single. 9 runs off the over!
Good fielding from Bangladesh's skipper! Length ball, outside off. Jason Roy pushes it back past the bowler. Mahmudullah runs to his right from mid off and keeps it to one.
Back of a length, around leg. Jos Buttler clips it behind square on the leg side for one.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Length ball, on middle. Jos Buttler stays back and whips it over the mid on fielder. The ball races away for a boundary.
Short of a length, around off. Jason Roy turns it to the right of the mid-wicket fielder and takes a run.
Wide! Islam spills this one way down leg. Jason Roy looks to pull but he misses. Wided!
Back of a length, on middle. Jason Roy comes down the track and turns it to mid-wicket.
Shoriful Islam comes into the attack now. He replaces Mustafizur Rahman.
Just a tad short, on middle. Jos Buttler hangs back and turns it to deep mid-wicket to collect a couple of runs.
Flatter ball, on middle. Jos Buttler rocks back to cut but finds the backward point fielder.
SIX! BANG! What a clean strike! Tossed up, on middle. Jos Buttler shimmies down and tonks it back over the bowler's head for a biggie!
Loopy ball, outside off. Jason Roy drills it to long off for a single.
Flatter ball, on off. Jason Roy cuts hard but straight to the cover fielder.
Tossed up, on middle. Jos Buttler tucks it to the leg side for one.
FOUR! STREAKY! Full ball, outside off. Jason Roy reaches out and looks to drive away from his body. It takes the inside edge and the ball goes into the fine leg fence.
FOUR! Nicely done! Length ball, on off. Roy comes forward and drives it back past the bowler to collect a boundary.
Wide! Rahman spills this one down leg. Jason Roy misses the flick and the umpire signals wide!
Leg bye! Length ball, strayed on the pads. Buttler misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls away to the leg side for a leg bye.
Length ball, around off. Jos Buttler looks to drive on the up but it takes the inner half of the blade towards mid on.
Good-length ball, on off. Jos Buttler drives it to mid off.

Leg bye! A huge appeal for LBW but turned down! Good-length ball, angling in from middle. Jason Roy misses his nudge and gets hit on the pads. The batters sneak in a leg bye as the fielder has a shy at the bower's end but misses. That pitched outside leg and hence the umpire did not seem interested.
Mustafizur Rahman to bowl from the other end.
A tad quicker, around off. Jos Buttler hangs back and punches it to cover. 7 runs off the first over!
This is fuller in length, outside off. Jason Roy prods and works it to long off for a run.
Flatter ball, darted on the pads. Jos Buttler tucks it to the leg side and rotates the strike.
Tossed up, outside off. Jos Buttler punches it to cover.
Loopy ball, around off. Jason Roy eases it to long off for a run.
FOUR! Jason Roy and England are up and running! Tossed up, outside off. Roy waits for it and cuts it past point for a boundary.
